reports.title: Kodiak Gas Services Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results, Increases Full Year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA and Discretionary Cash Flow Guidance

guidance.heading: Full-Year 2026 Guidance
section: Kodiak is providing revised guidance for the full year 2026. The full year 2026 guidance below incorporates three quarters of the financial impact of the DPS acquisition given the April 1, 2026 closing date.

(in thousands, excluding percentages) | Low | High
Adjusted EBITDA (1) | 840,000 | 860,000
Discretionary cash flow (1)(2) | 580,000 | 600,000
Compression Infrastructure revenue | 1,255,000 | 1,275,000
Compression Infrastructure adjusted gross margin percentage (1) | 69.5 | 70.5
Power Infrastructure revenue | 100,000 | 120,000
Power Infrastructure adjusted gross margin percentage (1) | 65.0 | 70.0
Other Services revenue | 125,000 | 160,000
Other Services adjusted gross margin percentage (1) | 12.0 | 15.0
Maintenance capital expenditures | 80,000 | 90,000
Compression Infrastructure | 290,000 | 310,000
Power Infrastructure | 350,000 | 400,000
Total Growth capital expenditures | 640,000 | 710,000
Other capital expenditures (3) | 45,000 | 55,000
(2)Discretionary cash flow guidance assumes no change to Secured Overnight Financing Rate futures.

(3)Other capital expenditures guidance excludes a $42.6 million non-cash finance lease addition related to one of our operational offices. Although recognized in the second quarter of 2026 capital expenditures, this non-cash activity is not reflected in the investing section of our statement of cash flows and is therefore excluded from our full-year capital expenditures guidance.
